text: As a friction, more standards reach you than you can meet, and each one tests your worth. You end up spent and never sure it was enough.

Being hard on yourself is the pressure you never question. Before anyone outside can judge you, you have judged yourself, and you would sooner be hard on yourself than hear it from them. You pay for getting there first with a peace you never get back.

Managing without asking is what you do best. The Water in you runs deeper than anyone sees, and you choose doing it alone rather than asking for company. You miss out on the ease that help would have given you.
Running over, the depth churns with no outlet. You need to prove yourself among friends, and the drive never lets you stop.
